name: Koa Shoji Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Koa Shoji Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, imports and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in Japan. It operates through Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Sales Business and Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Sales Business segments. The company is involved in the manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs and pharmacologically active injection. It also engages in contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals; and purchase and sale of pharmaceuticals. Koa Shoji Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
